title: Schedules of professional involvement
purpose: This variance recognizes the attached schedules of professional involvement as an alternative solution to the requirements in Articles 2.4.3.1, 2.4.3.2. and 2.4.4.1. of Division C of the National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)).
discussion: The schedules of professional involvement were first introduced in the 1997 Edition of the Alberta Building Code (ABC 1997) at the request of the Alberta Association of Architects (AAA) and the Association of Professional Engineers and Geoscientists of Alberta (APEGA). Only minor revisions have been made to the schedules of professional involvement since their introduction 1997. The requirements for the schedules of professional involvement are contained in Articles 2.4.3.1., 2.4.3.2. and 2.4.4.1. of Division C of the NBC(AE) and the schedules of professional involvement are provided in Appendix B of the NBC(AE). AAA and APEGA reviewed the schedules of professional involvement in the NBC(AE) and provided Municipal Affairs with revised schedules of professional involvement for use in the Alberta safety codes system. The revised schedules of professional involvement contain major changes to the content, including a different process from what is required by Section 2.4. of Division C of the NBC(AE). AAA and APEGA also created a helpful user guide on the schedules of professional involvement that can be found on their respective association websites. alberta.ca/building-codes-and-standards.aspx
variance_text: This variance provides approximately equivalent or greater safety performance with respect to persons and property as that provided for by the Safety Codes Act and the NBC(AE). The attached schedules of professional involvement provide approximately equivalent or greater safety as the requirements in Articles 2.4.3.1., 2.4.3.2. and 2.4.4.1. of Division C of the NBC(AE). See Appendix A.
variance_parts: This variance provides approximately equivalent or greater safety performance with respect to persons and property as that provided for by the Safety Codes Act and the NBC(AE). The attached schedules of professional involvement provide approximately equivalent or greater safety as the requirements in Articles 2.4.3.1., 2.4.3.2. and 2.4.4.1. of Division C of the NBC(AE). applies_to: This variance applies to all projects where the schedules of professional involvement are required by Articles 2.4.3.1., 2.4.3.2. and 2.4.4.1. of Division C of the NBC(AE). alberta.ca/building-codes-and-standards.aspx
